contradictions.why: The approach variant warns of two fords but only one ford is described anywhere on the route.

claims.says: This is a different drainage from the South Fork Skokomish/Six Ridge approach used for Olson and doesn't directly affect it
THE EASTERN SIX RIDGE TRAIL IS CURRENTLY CLOSED ... because of the 2025 fire

contradictions.why: Access says the 2025 fire closure does not affect the Olson approach while the bivy says it closes the eastern Six Ridge Trail.
contradictions.internal_resolution: Both agree the South Fork approach is open; only the eastern Staircase approach is affected.
